7847.title: Docs fork loses Markdown callback types
7847.rootCauseOneLine: The fork resolves markdown-it 15 ESM types through tiptap-markdown's incompatible namespace import, removing contextual parameter types from two Docs renderers.

prReviews.topFinding: Explicit local callback parameter types match the verified failure mechanism; no PR code was run.

7847.proposedFix: Explicitly type both renderer callbacks using the existing local token shape and a numeric index; validate with the external-fork checker. Existing PR #7848 already proposes this local repair.
7847.caveats: Two clean main checkouts reproduced the failure. The actual declaration selected is .d.mts. Historical CI runs and PR code were not executed.
